grades.quote:
It is expected that BootROM will set `mseccfg.MMWP` and/or `mseccfg.MML` during early boot, before jumping to the

firmware, so that the firmware will be able to determine the presence of Smepmp by reading `mseccfg` and checking the state of `mseccfg.MMWP` and `mseccfg.MML` .
grades.reason: Provides a concrete mechanism for discovering Smepmp support, but not processor identity or broader instruction-set support.
Describes compatibility and exception behavior, not facilities for discovering processor identity or supported instructions.

grades.quote: It should be pointed out that the subset of features added in each new version has its own identifier in the CPUCFG instruction return value. It is recommended that the software use this information rather than the version number of the Godson architecture to determine the supported features of the running processor.
grades.reason: Directly identifies CPUCFG as the facility for discovering supported features, but does not explain processor-identity discovery.
